Name: Polaris
Description: Keys and dials for your Polaris: send a message, set your status, see unread messages, alarms and deployments, and switch the devices in your places.

io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.key.Name: Polaris key
io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.key.Tooltip: Runs a Polaris action or shows its live state.

io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.dial.Name: Polaris dial
io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.dial.Tooltip: Adjusts a Polaris device, such as a light's brightness.

io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.timer.Name: Timer
io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.timer.Tooltip: A countdown or stopwatch. Press to start or pause, hold to reset.
